name: Global Congress on Cardiology & Cardiovascular Medicine
tagline: Global Congress on Cardiology & Cardiovascular Medicine
theme_primary: Translating discovery into practice — and into patient outcomes
theme_blurb: Translating discovery into practice — and into patient outcomes. Where breakthrough cardiology research becomes everyday clinical care for every patient.
hero_subtitle: An intimate two-day congress convening cardiology's researchers, clinicians and industry leaders.
about_heading: Where Cardiology meets the next decade.
about_lead: GCCM 2027 is a global forum for pioneering research, clinical translation and cross-disciplinary dialogue across the full spectrum of cardiology.
about_body: Across two days of keynotes, parallel technical tracks, poster sessions and focused workshops, we convene the brightest minds to chart the frontier of cardiology — from laboratory science to clinical impact.
